chapter.verse: Tua laitakin Ukpi Herod in Jesu' thu kigente a zak ciangin
a sawltangzangte' kiangah, “Hih mipa Baptizepa John hi. Amah sihna pan kithokiksak khinta hi; tua hangin hih nalamdangte ama' sungah a gamtang ahi hi,” ci hi.
A hang pen Herod in a sanggampa Philip ii zi Herodias' huhau-in John manin khau khihin thong sungah khum hi.
A thu pen John in Herod' kiangah, “Tua nu na tenpih pen phaltheih thu hilo hi,” a cihna hang ahi hi.
Herod in John that nuam a, ahi zongin mihonpi in John kamsang khatin sang uh ahih manin mihonpi kihta zel hi.
Ahih hangin Herod' suahni pawi hun hong tung a, pawi sungah Herodias' tanu a laam ciangin Herod lungkim ahih manin
a nget peuhpeuh pia ding ci-in kiciamna kam pau hi.
Numeino in zong a nu' sawlna bangin, “Hih takah, kuangdai khat tungah Baptizepa John' lutang hong pia in,” ci-in ngen hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa dah a, ahi zongin ama' kiciamna kam leh ama' lengla teng a khualna-in piak dingin thupia hi.
Tua ciangin mi sawlin thong sungah John' ngawng tansak hi.
Kuangdai khat tawh a lutang kipaipihin numeino' kiangah kipia a, numeino in a nu' kiangah paipih hi.
Tua ciangin John' nungzuite hong pai-in misiluang la uh a, a vui khit uh ciangin Jesu' kiangah pai-in gen uh hi.
Jesu in hih thu a zak ciangin tua mun pan amah guak gunkuang khat tawh gamlak simtham mun ah kihemkhia hi. Ahih hangin mite in tua thu a zak ciangin khua tuamtuam panin khe tawh nungzuih uh hi.
Tuinawl piau a tun ciangin Jesu in mihon tampi mu a, hehpihhuai sa ahih manin a cinate uh damsak hi.

Nitak lam ciangin Jesu' kiangah nungzuite hong pai-in, “Hih tak pen gamlak simtham mun hi a, ni zong tum ta ahih manin mite hih kimnai khuatate ah pai-in a an ding uh a va lei nadingun sawlkhia in,” ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesu in, “Mite a paikhiat uh kul lo hi. Amaute nektheih khatpeuh pia un,” ci hi.
Nungzuite in, “Hih takah anlum pum nga leh ngasa tawn nih bek i nei hi,” ci uh hi.
Jesu in, “Tuate hih takah ka kiangah hong paipih un,” ci hi.

Tua ciangin mite lopa tungah tu dingin thupia hi. Anlum pum nga leh ngasa tawn nih la-in vantung lam ento a, hehpihna a phat khit ciangin anlum leh ngasa balnenin nungzuite pia hi. Nungzuite in zong mihonpi piasawn hi.
Mi khempeuh in ne uh a, a vekun gilvah tek uh hi. Tua ciangin nungzuite in khamval anneng teng khawm uh a, lawhbeu sawmlenih dim ngah uh hi.
An a ne pen numei leh naupang kisim lo, pasal cingteng tulnga kiim pha hi.
Tua khit phetin Jesu in mihonpi a ciahsak kawmin nungzuite gunkuang sung lutsakin galkhat lamah paikholsak hi.
Mihonpi a ciahsak khit ciangin thungen dingin Jesu amah kia mualtung ah paito hi. Khuamial ciangin tua lai-ah amah kia bek hita hi.
Tua laitak tuinawl leitang pan gamlapi a tung khin gunkuang pen huih in lehmut ahih manin tuihualte in nawkgawp hi.
Zan hun bei kuan ciangin Jesu tui tungah lampai-in nungzuite' kiang zuan hi.
Ahi zongin Jesu tui tunga lampai a muh uh ciangin nungzuite patau linglawng uh a, “Sikha!” ci-in launa tawh awng uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in amaute hopih pah a, “Lungnuam un. Keimah ka hi hi. Lau kei un,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Peter in, “Topa aw, nang na hih takpi leh tui tunga nang' kiangah kong pai theih nading thupiak hong nei in,” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Hong pai in,” a cih ciangin Peter zong gunkuang pan kumkhia a, tui tungah lampai-in Jesu' kiang zuan hi.
Ahi zongin huihpi nung a muh ciangin lau a, tui sungah tum dektak ahih manin, “Topa aw, hong hon in,” ci-in awng hi.
Thakhat thu-in Jesu in a khut zankhia-in Peter len a, “Upna neu neipa aw, bang hangin muanglah na hi hiam?” ci hi.
Gunkuang sung a tun uh ciangin huihpi dai hi.
Tua ciangin gunkuang sunga om teng in Jesu bia uh a, “Nang pen Pasian' Tapa na hi taktak hi,” ci uh hi.
Tui a kantan khit uh ciangin Gennesaret leigam tung uh hi.
Tua mun-a om mite in Jesu ahihlam a theih uh ciangin tua gam kimkot bup ah thu zasak uh a, cina khempeuh ama' kiangah paipih uh hi.
Ama' puansilh khaukai beek a lawnkhak nadingun Jesu' kiangah thum uh a, a lawngkha khempeuh in damna ngah uh hi.
